title: Shipped grids: vote cards for items and Stories, a proposals include, votes on the cards
description:
Repo: **Papyrus** (grid subjects) and **Shipped-web** (page). Fold-in note b: Shipped's public units are items, Stories and proposals, not References, and its cards carry votes. Make the home-page grids able to show those subjects with the reader-steering vote island on each card.

## Change
1. Papyrus `::include{kind="listing"}` already renders Stories and items (any `listings.types`); add `card="vote"`: the standard card plus a `::island{name="Vote" props='{"subject": "item:<lineage>"}'}` mount (reader-steering's `Vote` island, mounted today by Shipped's `hooks.py`; the island and its props contract are in the papyrus-reader version-1 bundle (`_plugins/papyrus-reader-v1` js)). The include emits the island only when the site has the reader-steering plugin's assets configured (`IslandSettings`), else the plain card.
2. Proposals: `_data/proposals/index.json` is written by reader-steering (`proposals.publish: true`); add `::include{kind="proposals" count="6"}` in `home_page_components.py` reading that file through `HomePageSource` (same digest folding), card = title, vote count as text with a Lucide `arrow-big-up` icon, "proposal" label. "Proposed Story" wording where a proposal is a story idea; never "Draft".
3. Shipped-web `web/pages/newsroom.md` uses both; `hooks.py` stops hand-mounting the Vote island on the pages the include now covers (leave item pages alone).

## Gherkin (`features_backend/home-page-vote-cards.feature`)
  Scenario: A listing with card="vote" mounts a Vote island per card when reader-steering assets are configured
  Scenario: Without reader-steering the vote card renders as the plain card
  Scenario: The proposals include renders the published proposals with counts as text
  Scenario: Page-level de-duplication applies across listing and proposals includes

## Acceptance
Fixture renders; Shipped page shows votes on its cards; reader-privacy scan clean; `docs/home-page.md` "Vote cards and proposals". Blocked by the Shipped public-pages task.
